name: billables
description: Turns captured desktop activity into a reviewable billable timesheet and, on your explicit confirmation, logs it to your timesheet provider.

HARVEST_ACCOUNT_ID.title: Harvest account ID
HARVEST_ACCOUNT_ID.description: The numeric account ID shown at the top of https://id.getharvest.com/developers.

HARVEST_API_KEY.title: Harvest personal access token
HARVEST_API_KEY.description: A personal access token from https://id.getharvest.com/developers. Member scope is enough.

TIMESHEET_TIMEZONE.title: Your timezone
TIMESHEET_TIMEZONE.description: IANA name, e.g. Europe/London or Pacific/Auckland. Decides where your day starts and ends; there is no default, because guessing it would mis-date someone else's timesheet.

TIMESHEET_ACTIVITY_URL.title: ActivityWatch address
TIMESHEET_ACTIVITY_URL.description: Base URL of the ActivityWatch server holding your activity. Leave blank unless it runs somewhere other than http://localhost:5600. Not sure? Leave it as it is and run /billables:setup.

TIMESHEET_SCREENSHOTS_DIR.title: Screenshot directory
TIMESHEET_SCREENSHOTS_DIR.description: Where the capture task writes screenshots. Leave blank for ~/Pictures/WorkScreenshots. Not sure? Leave it as it is and run /billables:setup.

TIMESHEET_WORKSPACE.title: Workspace directory
TIMESHEET_WORKSPACE.description: The folder this plugin keeps your work in: a Timesheets/ folder with one file per day you review, and a hidden copy of your projects and tasks so it need not ask for them on every run. Leave blank to use the folder you run Claude Code from. Not sure? Leave it as it is and run /billables:setup.

TIMESHEET_OUTLOOK_CALENDAR.title: Read my Outlook calendar
TIMESHEET_OUTLOOK_CALENDAR.description: Reads your default calendar in classic Outlook (Windows only) as a fourth source: a calendar event your activity corroborates is drafted as a block, and one it does not is put to you as a question. Off means today's behaviour exactly. Not sure? Leave it as it is and run /billables:setup.
